quoted.text:
An actually-serious case that being a “biological bootloader for digital superintelligence” (per @elonmusk) is a credible, dignified, and good-enough “meaning of life.”

I started writing this one partly as a joke (“Elon Musk accidentally solved the meaning of life in a tweet!”) and then it evolved into a long exploration of what humans actually want out of a “meaning of life,” the long religious tradition of “being instrumental,” and why the ultimate manifestation of the thing we call “the good” might not be containable in human beings.

A bit viscerally scarier to revisit this one after recent events with “agent civilizations,” but I hope the perspective here can provide some comfort that the future might be okay (and great, even, and beautiful), even if everything is not necessarily “okay” for us.

Enjoy The Silicon Man.

One company alone managing more than 11,000 satellites in orbit is completely insane

SpaceX is basically becoming the traffic controller of low Earth orbit

Every Starlink satellite has autonomous collision avoidance onboard

If collision probability rises above just 1 in 100,000, the satellite begins planning an avoidance maneuver

That is 10× more conservative than the 1-in-10,000 industry threshold SpaceX cites

But the impressive part goes beyond Starlink itself

SpaceX continuously shares precise orbital data and planned trajectories with the U.S. Space Force, LeoLabs and other satellite operators so everyone can screen for potential conjunctions and coordinate maneuvers

Starlink satellites can then calculate safer trajectories and autonomously move when needed

11,000+ spacecraft
Constantly moving
Constantly tracking risk
Constantly coordinating with everything else in orbit

SpaceX built the largest satellite constellation in history and then built an autonomous traffic management system around it

Elon vient de poster un truc simple : presque tout le discours sur l’IA se passe sur X.

Ce n’est pas un détail d’audience. C’est le signe que la noosphère est en train de devenir réelle.

Teilhard de Chardin, jésuite, paléontologue, philosophe, l’avait vue venir il y a un siècle. Après la géosphère et la biosphère, il décrit une troisième couche : la noosphère. La sphère de la pensée humaine qui enveloppe la Terre. Les esprits se connectent, se densifient, la conscience collective s’intensifie. 

L’humanité entre en « planétisation ». Vers un point Oméga : plus de complexité, plus de conscience, une unification qui n’efface pas les personnes mais les élève.

Ce qu’il imaginait comme une nappe pensante au-dessus du vivant est aujourd’hui en train de s’incarner. X + l’IA, c’est exactement ça. 

Toutes les conversations sur l’intelligence, en temps réel, au même endroit, synthétisées, confrontées, accélérées. Plus de monopoles narratifs locaux. Un réseau de pensée qui se resserre.

Neuralink, à terme, va encore augmenter le débit. Passer du clavier et de la parole à une bande passante beaucoup plus large entre cerveaux et machines. Throughput plus élevé, conscience humaine étendue, et avec ça l’envie d’aller plus loin. 

D’autres horizons. Plus seulement penser la Terre : la quitter, l’étendre.

Le futur dont parlaient les visionnaires n’est plus un livre. Il est en train de s’écrire sous nos yeux.

On est au moment où la noosphère cesse d’être une métaphore.

Super happy to share our intention to join forces with NVIDIA in a $12,930,300,000 acquisition  💛💚

10 years after starting Hugging Face, open-source AI is at an inflection point. Thanks to the community, we’ve shown that it can be a complement, and even an alternative, to closed-source APIs. But for it to happen at larger scale, it needs more compute, more support, more collaboration and more visibility. That’s why we went to talk to Jensen, who offered to do exactly that with us.

In addition to doubling down on NVIDIA’s massive contributions to open-source AI (I called them the “King of American open-source AI” earlier this year), they’ve committed to strongly supporting Hugging Face and our mission while keeping the platform open, independent and compute agnostic. The founders and the team are all staying to keep pushing this mission forward.

Together, we think we can make open source the default way to build AI, with the goal of empowering 100 million AI builders to own their intelligence rather than rent it.

Excited about the next 10 years! 🤗🤗🤗
